nodes.summary: Let $h$ and $a$ be natural numbers with $h \ge 2$. If $a$ is the fourth positive element $a_4(h)$ of the greedy $B_h$-set, then $a \ge v(h)$, where $v(h) = (h^3 + 3h^2 + 3h + 1)/2$ if $h$ is odd and $v(h) = (h^3 + 2h^2 + 3h + 2)/2$ if $h$ is even.
nodes.title: Lower bound for the fourth greedy $B_h$ term

nodes.summary: For a natural number $h$, the value $v(h)$ is $(h^3 + 3h^2 + 3h + 1)/2$ if $h$ is odd and $(h^3 + 2h^2 + 3h + 2)/2$ if $h$ is even.
nodes.title: Quasipolynomial for the fourth greedy $B_h$ term

nodes.summary: For every integer $h \ge 1$, the fourth positive element $a_4(h)$ of the greedy $B_h$-set is $(h^3 + 3h^2 + 3h + 1)/2$ if $h$ is odd and $(h^3 + 2h^2 + 3h + 2)/2$ if $h$ is even.
nodes.title: Formula for the fourth greedy $B_h$ term

nodes.summary: Let $h$ and $a$ be natural numbers with $h \ge 1$. If $a$ is the fourth positive element $a_4(h)$ of the greedy $B_h$-set, then $a \le v(h)$, where $v(h) = (h^3 + 3h^2 + 3h + 1)/2$ if $h$ is odd and $v(h) = (h^3 + 2h^2 + 3h + 2)/2$ if $h$ is even.
nodes.title: Upper bound for the fourth greedy $B_h$ term

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $h$ and $a$, we say that $a$ is the fourth positive element $a_4(h)$ of the greedy $B_h$-set if $1$ is the next greedy $B_h$ choice after $\{0\}$, $h + 1$ is the next greedy $B_h$ choice after $\{0, 1\}$, $h^2 + h + 1$ is the next greedy $B_h$ choice after $\{0, 1, h + 1\}$, and $a$ is the next greedy $B_h$ choice after $\{0, 1, h + 1, h^2 + h + 1\}$.
nodes.title: Fourth positive term of the greedy $B_h$-set

nodes.summary: Let $h$ and $a$ be natural numbers and $A$ a set of natural numbers. Then $a$ is the next greedy $B_h$ choice after $A$ if $a$ is greater than every element of $A$, the set $A \cup \{a\}$ is a $B_h$-set, and for every natural number $b < a$ that is greater than every element of $A$, the set $A \cup \{b\}$ is not a $B_h$-set.
nodes.title: Next term of a greedy $B_h$-set

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
